SELECT r.reason_code, s.store_id, count(*) n, count(distinct r.return_line_id) dist_id, sum(r.quantity_returned) units, min(r.quantity_returned) minq, max(r.quantity_returned) maxq, sum(r.refund_net) refund
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND cp.category='Garden' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH gf AS (
 SELECT r.*, s.store_id, cp.sku
 FROM fact_return_line r
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND cp.category='Garden' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
SELECT sum(g.quantity_returned) all_units, count(*) n,
 sum(case when g.store_id=999 then g.quantity_returned else 0 end) s999,
 sum(case when f.sales_line_id is null then g.quantity_returned else 0 end) orphan,
 sum(case when f.sales_line_id is not null and g.quantity_returned>f.quantity then g.quantity_returned else 0 end) over_qty,
 sum(case when f.sale_date>g.return_date then 1 else 0 end) before_sale,
 sum(case when f.product_key<>g.product_key then 1 else 0 end) prod_mismatch,
 sum(case when f.sale_date< g.return_date - 30 then 1 else 0 end) older30,
 count(*)-count(distinct g.sales_line_id) dup_sl
FROM gf g LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=g.sales_line_id

calls.statement:
SELECT 'as_is' k, sum(r.quantity_returned) u, count(*) n
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
UNION ALL
SELECT 'as_was', sum(r.quantity_returned), count(*)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sale_cohort_asis', sum(r.quantity_returned), count(*)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_pairs_all', count(*), 0 FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
